name: Shallum (husband of Huldah)
title: Keeper of the wardrobe, husband of the prophetess Huldah
summary: Shallum son of Tikvah was keeper of the wardrobe and husband of the prophetess Huldah, whom King Josiah's men consulted to hear the Lord's word when the Book of the Law was found.

keyEvents.title: Husband of the prophetess Huldah
keyEvents.description: Huldah, wife of Shallum who kept the wardrobe, delivered the Lord's message to King Josiah's envoys.
